The Process

MICHELIN-STAR
TECHNIQUE.
CAMPUS PRICE.

Sous vide (soo-veed) is the same technique used in Michelin-starred restaurants worldwide. Every Ultimate Chicken piece is vacuum-sealed and slow-cooked in a precisely controlled water bath — locking in moisture, flavour, and tenderness every single time.

Why Sous Vide? →
01
🌿

Marinate

Hand-marinated chicken breast with our proprietary flavor profiles. No MSG, no shortcuts.

02
🔒

Vacuum Seal

Sealed in BPA-free, food-grade PP/PE/PA pouches. Locks in flavor before cooking begins.

03
🌡️

Sous Vide

63°C water bath. Precise to the degree. Kills all bacteria. Preserves every nutrient. Michelin-star technique.

04
⚡

Ready

Eat straight from the wrapper. No heating, no mess, no time wasted. Just perfect chicken.
